introduction: Reach Up supports eligible Vermont families with dependent children through cash assistance and case management.
description: Reach Up supports eligible Vermont families with dependent children through cash assistance and case management.

sections.who: DCF considers income, living expenses, resources and household membership. The interview helps determine the family’s eligibility and needs.
sections.get: Monthly support helps meet basic needs; case management addresses goals such as employment, education, health and housing.
sections.docs:
• Household and child information.
  • Income, living expenses and resource evidence.
  • Requested identity and other verification.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use the online application linked on Reach Up, request paper intake at 800-479-6151, or visit a district office.

  2. Attend the interview

    Complete phone or in-person intake and provide evidence.

  3. Discuss safety and goals

    If pursuing child support creates a safety risk, ask the worker about a waiver.
sections.after: Follow your family plan and report changes. DCF considers eligible closing cases for Reach Ahead support.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current DCF Reach Up. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is this only a cash payment?
It includes case management and goal-related services.
DCF lists phone or in-person interviews.
What if child-support cooperation is unsafe?
Ask your case manager about a waiver.
Can support continue when cash closes?
DCF checks eligibility for Reach Ahead.
